modules.recommended_replacement: Keep entity classes as-is; remove virtual keyword from navigation properties for EF Core explicit/eager loading; no framework API changes required

Replace WCF ServiceContract/OperationContract/DataContract attributes with ASP.NET Core controller interface or define gRPC proto contract; migrate OrderDto and PlaceOrderRequest to plain C# records with System.Text.Json

Migrate Entity Framework 6 DbContext to EF Core DbContext (Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore); replace parameterless constructor with IConfiguration-injected connection string; add explicit .Include() calls to fix N+1 queries; move OrderReportService class to Services namespace
Move class from Models/AppDbContext.cs to Services/; replace direct DbContext instantiation with constructor injection; fix N+1 query by adding .Include(o => o.Customer) eager-load call

Rewrite as ASP.NET Core service class registered with DI container; remove WCF ServiceBehavior/InstanceContextMode.Single; inject AppDbContext via constructor; replace log4net 1.x with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging ILogger; convert all methods to async Task; add proper exception propagation instead of swallowing

Rewrite as ASP.NET Core ControllerBase; replace System.Web.Mvc.Controller base class; replace HttpContext.Current static access with injected IHttpContextAccessor; replace Session with IDistributedCache or TempData; replace Application cache with IMemoryCache; remove ViewBag in favour of strongly-typed ViewModels; add antiforgery via ASP.NET Core built-in middleware

Migrate Web.config to appsettings.json with IConfiguration; move connection string to environment variable or Azure Key Vault / user-secrets; remove system.serviceModel WCF block; replace Forms authentication with ASP.NET Core cookie authentication middleware; remove hardcoded PaymentGatewayApiKey and store in secrets manager
